inputs.goal: add SSO login to the web app in the platform repo

research.research_brief: SSO implementation for web app in platform repo requires investigation into existing authentication patterns, identity provider integration points, and security protocols. Must examine current login flow, identify SSO vendor options (OAuth2, SAML, OpenID Connect), and assess compatibility with platform architecture. Need to understand authentication middleware requirements, session management, user mapping strategies, and potential impacts on existing user data migration.
research.prior_art: Previous platform authentication implementations relied on JWT-based tokens with local user management. Existing web app uses React frontend with REST API backend. Current documentation shows basic login flow with username/password. OAuth2 integration exists for external services like GitHub. SAML implementation was explored in 2023 but not adopted due to complexity. Platform uses PostgreSQL with user roles and permissions defined in schema. No existing SSO solution has been deployed in production.

plan: Research and select SSO protocol (OAuth2/OpenID Connect) based on platform compatibility
Design authentication middleware architecture to support SSO integration
Implement SSO login flow in React frontend with proper error handling
Develop backend API endpoints for SSO token validation and user provisioning
Create database schema changes for SSO user mapping and session management
Test SSO implementation with mock identity provider
Validate user data migration strategy from local auth to SSO
Document SSO configuration, flow diagrams, and security measures
Perform integration testing with existing platform services
Prepare rollback plan if production deployment fails
acceptance_criteria: SSO login flow works seamlessly with platform's React frontend
Backend authentication middleware properly validates SSO tokens
User mapping between local and SSO identities functions correctly
Session management maintains user state across SSO boundaries
Security protocols (HTTPS, token encryption) are implemented per platform standards
Database schema changes compatible with existing platform structure
Documentation includes setup instructions and troubleshooting guide
Integration tests pass with existing platform services
Platform maintains backward compatibility for existing non-SSO users

implement.execute.step_result: Executed step: Research and select SSO protocol (OAuth2/OpenID Connect) based on platform compatibility. Found that OpenID Connect is most compatible with existing JWT-based authentication system and integrates well with current React/REST backend architecture. Recommended using Auth0 as the identity provider due to its ease of integration, robust documentation, and support for platform's technical requirements including HTTPS, token encryption, and user mapping strategies. Selected OpenID Connect v1.0 as the standard protocol for SSO implementation.
